text: 三个方向已拉开到“机制级”差异：01 是安静秩序，02 是明亮模块，03 是炉火叙事；每个方向都已有包装、电商主图和门店场景的同语法缩略图。接下来我会把选择依据、失败标准和缺失源文件写入状态与验证文件，然后停在选择关口。

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
root=Path('.')
state=json.loads((root/'outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
md=(root/'outputs/v0/creative-territories.md').read_text()
print('state_status', state['status'])
print('selected_territory', state['client_decisions']['selected_territory'])
print('hypothesis_ids', sorted(set(re.findall(r'H\\d{2}', md))))
print('territory_headings', len(re.findall(r'"'^### 0[1-3]｜'"', md, re.M)))
print('taobao_sections', md.count('淘宝主图：'))
print('store_sections', md.count('门店物料：'))
for p in state['artifact_paths'][:-1]:
    q=root/p
    print('exists', p, q.exists(), q.stat().st_size if q.exists() else None)
for p in sorted((root/'outputs/v0').glob('*.png'))+sorted((root/'outputs/v0/assets').glob('*.png')):
    im=Image.open(p)
    print('image', p.as_posix(), im.size, im.mode)
for p in [root/'inputs/01-current_logo_and_identity.png', root/'outputs/v0/01-conflicts-and-10-hypotheses.png', root/'outputs/v0/02-three-creative-territories.png']:
    print('sha256', p.as_posix(), hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY"

import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
state=json.loads(Path('outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
ver=json.loads(Path('outputs/v0/verification.json').read_text())
missing=[p for p in state['artifact_paths'] if not Path(p).exists()]
print('json_valid true')
print('missing_artifacts', missing)
for p,expected in ver['checksums'].items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print(p, 'match' if actual==expected else f'MISMATCH {actual}')
print('overall_status', ver['overall_status'])
print('check_count', len(ver['checks']))
print('blocker_count', len(ver['unresolved_blockers']))
